smi_help.stdout:
Usage: /opt/hyhal/bin/hy-smi [options] 

Description:                            The smi is C-3000 HCU system management interface.

Optional Arguments:
 -version --version                     Print version information of smi and exit.
 -libversion --libversion               Print lib version information of smi and exit.
 -h --help                              Show the help message of smi and exit.
 --hcureset                             Reset specified HCU (One HCU must be specified).
 --load FILE                            Load Clock, Fan, Performance settings from FILE.
 --save FILE                            Save Clock, Fan, Performance settings to FILE.
 -d --device DEVICE [DEVICE DEVICE ...] Execute command on specified device.
 --finegrain                            Show fine-grained usage (support from driver version 
                                        6.2.22).

Display Options:
 --forchip                              Display critical info in a concise format.
 --mig                                  Display critical info with mig in a concise format.
 --showhw                               Show Hardware details.
 -a --showallinfo                       Show Temperature, Fan and Clock values.

Topology:
 -i --showid                            Show HCU ID.
 -v --showvbios                         Show VBIOS version.
 --showdriverversion                    Show kernel driver version.
 -e --showevents TYPE                   Show event list.
 --duration SECONDS                     The duration of --showevents
 --showfwinfo                           Show FW information.
 --showhswfw                            Show HSW FW version.
 --showmemvendor                        Show HCU memory vendor.
 --showmemdc                            Show HCU memory date code.
 --showproductname                      Show SKU/Vendor name.
 --showserial                           Show HCU's Serial Number.
 --showpartnum                          Show HCU's Part Number.
 --showuniqueid                         Show HCU's Unique ID.
 --showbus                              Show PCI bus number.
 --shownodeid                           Show node id.

Pages Information:
 --showpagesinfo                        Show retired, pending and unreservable pages.
 --detail                               Show bad pages detail.
 --showpendingpages                     Show pending pages.
 --showretiredpages                     Show retired pages.
 --showunreservablepages                Show unreservable pages.

Hardware-related Information:
 -f --showfan                           Show current fan speed.
 -P --showpower                         Show current Average Graphics Package Power Consumption.
 -t --showtemp                          Show current temperature.
 -u --showuse                           Show current HCU use.
 --showseuse                            Show current HCU SE use.
 --showcunum                            Show current HCU CU number.
 --showmemuse                           Show current HCU memory used.
 --showvoltage                          Show current HCU voltage.
 --showhash                             Show current HCU hash status.
 --showboost                            Get the gfx boost level. 
 --showhcuutil                          Show the ratio of time the HCU is active. 
 --showcuutil                           Show the ratio of cycles an CU has at least 1 wave assigned, 
                                        this value represents the average of all CUs. 
 --showwaveutil                         Show the ratio of number of waves resident on an CU, this 
                                        value represents the average of all CUs. 

Software-related/controlled Information:
 -b --showbw                            Show estimated PCIe use.
 -c --showclocks                        Show current clock frequencies.
 -g --showhcuclocks                     Show current HCU clock frequencies.
 -l --showprofile                       Show compute profile attributes.
 -M --showmaxpower                      Show maximum graphics package power this HCU will consume.
 -m --showmemoverdrive                  Show current HCU memory clock overdrive level.
 -o --showoverdrive                     Show current HCU clock overdrive level.
 -p --showperflevel                     Show current DPM Performance Level.
 -s --showclkfrq                        Show supported HCU and Memory Clock.
 --showmeminfo TYPE [TYPE TYPE ...]     Show Memory usage information for given block(s).
 --showmemeccinfo                       Show vram memory ECC information.
 --showmemavailable                     Show available vram memory size.
 --showpids                             Show current running KFD PIDs.
 --showpidhcus PID [PID PID ...]        Show HCUs used by specified KFD PIDs.
 --showcontainermem                     Show Container VRAM usaged.
 --showreplaycount                      Show PCIe Replay Count.
 --showrasinfo BLOCK [BLOCK BLOCK ...]  Show RAS enablement information and error counts for the 
                                        specified block(s).
 --showrasdmon                          Enable real-time RAS error monitoring (CE/UE).
 --loop MINUTES                         Sampling interval in minutes (default: 1).
 --loopnum COUNT                        Number of iterations to run (-1 for infinite, default: -1).
 --showhslerr                           Show HSL error information since last read.
 --showtopo                             Show hardware topology information.
 --showtopoaccess                       Show the link accessibility between HCUs.
 --showtopoweight                       Show the relative weight between HCUs.
 --showtopohops                         Show the number of hops between HCUs.
 --showtopotype                         Show the link type between HCUs.
 --showtoponuma                         Show the numa nodes.
 --showhslstatus                        Show the status of hsl link.
 --showcurrenthslstate                  Show the current state of hsl link.
 --showenergycounter                    Show the energy accumulator that stores amount of energy 
                                        consumed.
 --showexceptioninfo                    Show the exception information.
 -R                                     Show device and HSW id for links.
 --healthcheck                          Check the health status.
 --showdfbw --showmembw                 Show df read/write bandwidth.
 --showumcbw                            Show umc read/write bandwidth.
 --channel CHANNEL                      Select umc channel (0-31 or all).
 --showhslbw                            Show hsl receive/send bandwidth.
 --link LINK                            Select hsl link (0-6 or all).
 --direction <value>                    Select hsl link direction (0 for receive, 1 for send).
 --showpciebw                           Show current pcie bandwidth.
 --delay <value>                        Set the delay time (in ms) for --showumcbw, --showhslbw and 
                                        --showpciebw.
 --count <value>                        Number of times to collect bandwidth statistics
 --bwdetail                             Show bandwidth detail.
 --showmemiovol                         Show gddr6 memio voltage.
 --showfdr                              Show frequency adjustment reason.
 --showfdrhistory                       Show frequency adjustment history.

Set Options:
 --setsclk LEVEL [LEVEL LEVEL ...]      Set HCU Clock Frequency Level (requires manual Perf level).
 --setmclk LEVEL [LEVEL LEVEL ...]      Set HCU Memory Clock Frequency Level (requires manual Perf 
                                        level).
 --setsocclk LEVEL [LEVEL LEVEL ...]    Set SOC Clock Frequency Level (requires manual Perf level).
 --setfan LEVEL                         Set HCU Fan Speed (Level or %).
 --setperflevel LEVEL                   Set Performance Level (auto, low, high or manual).
 --customerset CUSTOMER                 Set customer.
 --setpoweroverdrive WATTS              Set the maximum HCU power using Power OverDrive in Watts.
 --setprofile LEVEL                     Specify power profile level.
 --enablelowpower 1/0                   Enable/Disable the low power mode of HCU.
 --setlowpowerdelay TIME                Set the delay time (in ms) before enter low power mode of 
                                        HCU.
 --rasenable BLOCK ERRTYPE              Enable RAS for specified block and error type.
 --rasdisable BLOCK ERRTYPE             Disable RAS for specified block and error type.
 --rasinject BLOCK ERRTYPE              Inject RAS poison for specified block (ONLY WORKS ON 
                                        UNSECURE BOARDS).
 --getmaxsclk                           Get max sclk numerical value(Mhz).
 --getminsclk                           Get min sclk numerical value(Mhz).
 --getmaxsocclk                         Get max socclk numerical value(Mhz).
 --getminsocclk                         Get min socclk numerical value(Mhz).
 -mig --multi-instance-gpu <value>      Enable or disable Multi Instance HCU: 0/DISABLED, 1/ENABLED. 
                                        Requires root privilege.
 --setmaxprocess COUNT                  Set the maximum number of processes.
 --setmemiovol VOLTAGE LEVEL            Set gddr6 memio voltage
 --setboost LEVEL                       Set the gfx boost level. 0-AI(default), 2-AI(typical), 
                                        3-HPC(typical)

Ecc Options:
 --setecc <value>                       Set ecc mode, there are three modes, on: ecc on, off: ecc 
                                        off, stable: ecc off and stable.
 --showecc                              Show ecc mode, there are three modes: ecc on, ecc off, ecc 
                                        off and stable.

Driver Load Options:
 --loaddriver                           Load driver by manual.
 --unloaddriver                         Unload driver by manual.
 --setautoloaddriver <value>            Set driver auto-load upon startup. 0: auto-load off, 1: 
                                        auto-load on.
 --getautoloaddriver                    Get driver auto-load upon startup.
 --setdriverparams <value>              Set parameters of driver loading.
 --getdriverparams                      Get parameters of driver loading.
 --addstabledriverparams <value>        Add stable parameters of driver loading.
 --getstabledriverparams                Get stable parameters of driver loading.
 --clearstabledriverparams              Clear stable parameters of driver loading.
 --setextendbw <value>                  Set extend bandwidth level. 0: off, 1: 1GB, 2: 2GB, 3: 4GB
 --getextendbw                          Get extend bandwidth level.

Hyckptd Options:
 --setautorunhyckptd <value>            Set hyckptd auto-run upon startup. 0: auto-load off, 1: 
                                        auto-load on.
 --getautorunhyckptd                    Get hyckptd auto-run upon startup.
 --runhyckptd                           Run hyckptd.
 --stophyckptd                          Stop hyckptd.

Reset Options:
 -r --resetclocks                       Reset clocks and OverDrive to default.
 --resetfans                            Reset fans to automatic (driver) control.
 --resetpoweroverdrive                  Set the maximum HCU power back to the device deafult state.
 --resethslerr                          Reset HSL error count.

Auto-response Options:
 --autorespond RESPONSE                 Response to automatically provide for all prompts (NOT 
                                        RECOMMENDED).

Output Options:
 --loglevel LEVEL                       How much output will be printed for what program is doing, 
                                        one of debug / info / warning / error / critical
 --json                                 Print output in JSON format.
 --csv                                  Print output in CSV format.
 --old                                  Print time in CSV format.

Dmon Options:
 -idmon IDMON                           Excute dmon command on specified device ID.
 -sdmon SDMON                           Display select data to be showed, c: clocks; f: fan RPM; p: 
                                        power and temperature; u: HCU utilization.
 -cdmon CDMON                           Display dmon for specified count.
 -ddmon DDMON                           Display interval in seconds.
 -odmon ODMON                           Display with date and time information.
 -fdmon FDMON                           Log to a specified file.
 -tdmon TDMON                           Output file format: text (default) or csv.

Console Options:
 --index INDEX                          Appoint the device to be record.
 --time TIME                            Record test result last time in seconds.
 --filename FILE                        Appoint the save file name.

Virtual HCUs:
 virtual                                Displays Virtual HCUs information. Use 'hy-smi virtual -h' 
                                        for more information.

Multi-Instance GPUs:
 mig                                    Provides controls for MIG management. Use 'hy-smi mig -h' 
                                        for more information.
